# Задача: архитектура RISC-V-бинаря

Файл `riscv.elf` — бинарь под RISC-V. Определи целевую архитектуру по заголовку.

1. `readelf --file-header riscv.elf` (или `cat riscv.readelf.txt`).
2. Найди строку `Machine:`.
3. Запиши `machine=<значение>` в `answer.txt` и набери `check`.

ELF Header:
  Magic:   7f 45 4c 46 02 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 
  Class:                             ELF64
  Data:                              2's complement, little endian
  Version:                           1 (current)
  OS/ABI:                            UNIX - System V
  ABI Version:                       0
  Type:                              DYN (Position-Independent Executable file)
  Machine:                           RISC-V
  Version:                           0x1
  Entry point address:               0x13c4
  Start of program headers:          64 (bytes into file)
  Start of section headers:          1688 (bytes into file)
  Flags:                             0x5, RVC, double-float ABI
  Size of this header:               64 (bytes)
  Size of program headers:           56 (bytes)
  Number of program headers:         11
  Size of section headers:           64 (bytes)
  Number of section headers:         16
  Section header string table index: 14
